caption_txt.title: Tasmania Boosts State Nomination Places for 2026–27
body: Big update for anyone planning to apply for Tasmanian State Nomination: Tasmania has received 2,050 state nomination places for the 2026–27 program — 1,250 for Subclass 190 and 800 for Subclass 491.

That's a solid increase on last year: the 190 allocation is up from 1,200 to 1,250, and the 491 allocation has jumped from 650 to 800. Tasmania has also confirmed the State Nomination Program will reopen for new Registrations of Interest in the coming weeks, with the exact date to be announced soon.
